title: Agreement of the diagonal and tensor positive-line reductions
statement: For finite setting P, 1 ≤ m ≤ P.level, any X over its field, d ≥ 0 and every normalized CoefficientLineComparison e for the actual quotient, the fixed-pro-etale root-power map proTwistMap d e equals (P.finiteTensorPositiveReduction m hm hmn X d).hom. This compares coefficient lines only; f, omega and theta do not occur. The definitions used here are recorded in [def-pur-finite-reduction-tensor-factors], [def-pur-finite-smooth-coefficient-arrows], [def-pur-finite-root-tensor-presentation].

proof.text: Choose a primitive root at level P.level and its prescribed power at m. The root inclusion is mono, so roots_power determines the roots map; generators determines the sheaf arrow, and derived_normalization determines its scalar-counit single-complex arrow.

For zero powers both comparisons are the scalar unit multiplication. For a successor tensor power use the K-flat binary representative normalization of finiteTensorCore, and the single-complex adjunction normalization of finiteTensorLineComparison. Both maps reduce each ordered root generator to its quotient generator. The tensorPower recursion and scalar shift comparison give the same ordered derived product with the same even shift.

Conjugate by finiteTensorPositivePresentation. Its defining root-chart equation gives precisely the shifted diagonalTwist. The site/scalar comparison and intrinsic scalarPresentation are mates of the same sectionwise identity restriction square. Their unit/counit triangles identify the two displayed arrows. This includes d=0, equal levels and ramified coefficient rings.

lean.statement: theorem finiteReduction_positiveLineComparison (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hmn : m ≤ P.level) (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))] (d : ℕ) (e : CoefficientLineComparison (quotient P m hm hmn) P.diagonalExponent (P.finiteReductionSetting m hm).diagonalExponent P.diagonalExponent_annihilates (P.finiteReductionSetting m hm).diagonalExponent_annihilates X) : proTwistMap d e = (P.finiteTensorPositiveReduction m hm hmn X d).hom
